findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured history for insider buys on this name; chair buying on Q2 day did not stop the -8% reaction.

findings.why_not_priced: Holders bought the 14.5% yield story; a seasonal cash dip or no new buy-back is not what a yield holder is positioned for, but the pattern is visible in last year's Q3 report to anyone who looked.
